sentence: This project builds a tool that uses several cameras and AI to classify snowflakes and rebuild their 3D shapes.
This project improves and shares teaching materials about electrophysiology for courses on cognitive neuroscience research.
This project uses theory to study neutrinos, tiny particles made in stars and supernova explosions, to learn about those objects.
This project builds methods that keep vision-based autonomous systems safe when the visual environment changes, such as with sun glares or snow-covered terrain.
This project builds a system that uses biosensors to sense stress in hospital patients and adjusts the indoor environment to reduce it.
This project uses simulations and experiments to predict how kirigami sheets with cut patterns behave in flowing fluid.
This project studies how artificial intelligence writing tools can be designed responsibly for college writing.
This project develops a way to grow polymers on the surface of cells and studies how this labeling affects cell health.
This project studies how mRNA molecules injected into T-cells make protein over time and how long that protein lasts.
This project studies how quantum computers can find solutions to problems and how that differs from only detecting whether a solution exists.
This project builds computer tools that use machine learning to find traits of living organisms in images.
This project builds versions of the Kyber scheme for post-quantum cryptography that resist attacks using physical leakages or induced faults.
This project studies how protein complexes in fruit fly stem cells set up uneven cell divisions that make different cell types.
This project creates four courses that study Drosophila melanogaster mutants to learn how genes relate to growth and development.
This project builds a way to turn task descriptions in natural language into safe, checked plans for autonomous systems.
This project uses a deep learning model to classify galaxies by shape in astronomical images and studies how shape relates to galaxy formation.
This project studies how quarks and gluons come together to form bound states after high-energy particle collisions.
This project studies how genes control the making of nerve cells in different parts of the gut in zebrafish.
